paper_title: Learning to Reason under Off-Policy Guidance
caption: : Ratio of clipped signals.

annotations.annotation: The line plot illustrates the clip ratio percentage over a series of steps for two different policies. The x-axis is labeled "Steps" with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 400, with tick labels at intervals of 200. The y-axis is labeled "Clip Ratio (%)" with a linear scale from 0.00 to 0.20, displaying tick labels at intervals of 0.05. There are two lines on the plot. The first line, representing the "On-policy," is colored blue with a solid line style and no markers. It starts around 0.0% at the beginning, then sudden increase to 0.07 in approximately 10 steps, then slightly fluctuates, and remains relatively steady around 0.05 value as it progresses. The second line is red, representing the "Mixed-policy w/ Shaping," also solid and without markers. It starts at approximately 0.0%, then increases to around 0.20% by around 10 steps, and then decreases sharply, continuing to fluctuate and stabilizing around 0.10% towards the end. A legend is placed at the top center of the plot to describe the line and its policy.
